annotations.title: Prepare a Loan My Coins introduction request

description: Returns the programme, enquiry type, and acquisition-source context for the Loan My Coins introduction form, and where a person can complete it. Programme is always lmc and the enquiry type is always bitcoin_loan_referral. An LMC introduction never creates a TBA advisory commission. It does not fill personal fields and does not submit anything. Only a person submits the form.
